newsitem.title: UK: BFI unchanged as rates stabilise.
newsitem.headline: BFI unchanged as rates stabilise.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) was unchanged at 1,369 points reflecting the broad situation in the freight market.

Brokers said a high volume of Panamax fixtures has been reported in both the Atlantic and Pacific at stable rates although brokers beleived that a slight weakening in levels may shortly be expected for August.

Capers remained weak in the early positions although propspects from second-half August are said to be better for owners and Handy-sized conditions are generally unchanged, weak in the Atlantic and fairly steady in the East.
At 1200 GMT BIFFEX was one point lower to five points higher and turnover was 49 lots.
